inputs.text: The Uttar Pradesh government has failed to show any real leadership by not setting up a clear process for brick kiln operators to get environmental clearances three months after the mandate, leaving these traditional businesses mired in confusion and hit with unfair criticism. These operators already hold the proper approvals from the State Pollution Control Board on water and air quality, and they stand ready to meet extra requirements if the state would simply streamline the system and cut out middlemen interference. Legal experts may keep pushing strict compliance with recent court decisions, but the priority must be firm authority from the top to create a workable framework. This regulatory tangle is damaging our traditional local industries that sustain families, uphold social order, and strengthen the nation.
